description: Evolve chess LLM training strategy for <8B model to minimize ACPL

problem.goal: Train a <8B parameter LLM to play chess from text with minimal ACPL
problem.input: FEN position + legal moves in UCI format
problem.metric: Average Centipawn Loss (ACPL) - lower is better

optimization_strategies.name: training_data
optimization_strategies.description: Select and filter training data (SF1 vs SF3 vs mixed)

optimization_strategies.name: hyperparameters
optimization_strategies.description: Tune LoRA rank, learning rate, epochs

optimization_strategies.name: game_phase_focus
optimization_strategies.description: Weight training on openings vs middlegame vs endgame

optimization_strategies.name: curriculum_learning
optimization_strategies.description: Order training from easy to hard positions

constraints: Must run on AWS Trainium (trn1.2xlarge) at inference
No external search/Stockfish at inference time
